The average person lives about twenty seven thousand days.
Take away sleep, and you're left with eighteen thousand.
Then take away the scrolling. The waiting. The, I'll start tomorrow.
Most people don't run out of time. They waste it, one day at a time.
But one focused hour a day adds up to fifteen full days a year.
Fifteen days to learn a skill. Build your body. Start something.
You can't add more days to your life.
But you can add more life to your days.
Today is one of them. Use it.
